ms.text:
MP1
Apparatus: (stop)watch / clock / timer
MP2
Method: Heat water in a container to a specified temperature or to boiling point
MP3
Method: Repeat for at least two additional containers
MP4
Constant Variable: Volume of water
MP5
Constant Variable: Starting temperature (of water)
OR room temperature OR power of heater
MP6
Table with columns to match their method. If MP2 correct, this needs type of container and time with unit (s)
MP7
Compare times / durations (for the various containers) OR see which takes longer.
